name: Westbound Panama Canal Transit Day Morning Pastry Carts & Pool Deck BBQ Lunch
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Panama Canal Transit Day (Deck 9 & 10)
whyItWorks: During the 6:00 AM–4:00 PM lock transit, DCL rolls out morning croissant/fruit carts on the open decks followed by an outdoor poolside grill station with carved meats and burgers.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Grab a plain butter croissant and banana from the morning viewing carts, and choose plain carved chicken, sirloin, or a plain burger patty on a white bun at the midday deck BBQ.
watchOuts: Stay hydrated in high tropical humidity during the 8-hour transit
Skip smoky BBQ sauce and mayonnaise slaw sitting in the sun
